Hooked routines

Psi-5 Trading Company (Accolade, 1985) in the Avatar +4D 101% release, packed as an EasyFlash cartridge with a 1351 mouse patch: the cartridge's unchanged 6502 code runs on a JS 6502 core, from the trainer prompt through the course list and crew selection to the bridge. The VIC is drawn line by line from the register writes logged at each raster position; the SID is replayed in an AudioWorklet. There are no ROMs: an original font stands in for the character ROM, and the KERNAL is a stand-in with just the interrupt entry and SETLFS / SETNAM that the game calls. QUIT reloads from disk and does not work. Labels come from the reverse-engineering notes (js/psi5-symbols.txt). Save states are kept in this browser.
